text.tspan: May your spirit and your soul
Various Aspects of the Inner Life — The Tripartite Man
There’s an outer part of me—
But there’s more to me than this—
More than this, more than this.
Yes, my body’s where I live—
Like my house, I am inside,
Like the clothes that I may wear,
Deeper than the part you see
Is my soul—yes, that is me!
And this soul has its own parts:
With my soul I feel and think,
With this soul my choices make,
With my soul I love and choose—
Love the Lord! Choose the Lord!
There’s a special part of me—
This one part just matches God—
Here my conscience speaks for Him,
It’s reserved just for the Lord—
May your spirit and your soul
By our God! God of peace!
Your whole being, till He comes,
Be kept blameless and so pure,
